## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently randomized complex photographic test of newly implemented model/editorial concepts, using the attached portrait. This arm chooses a product-led jewelry campaign; the detailed scene is agent-owned.
subject: One 28-year-old adult female photographic subject based on visible face and hair features of the attached portrait
setting: Observatory instrument room at blue hour
event: She lifts a meteorite specimen tray while the silver cuff on her left wrist remains fully legible
visual_priorities: The silver cuff and oval green cabochon are the commercial product hero
Reference-derived facial and hair appearance remains recognizable
Both hands carry one plausible lightweight tray interaction
baseline_prompt_en: Create a product-led jewelry campaign photograph of one 28-year-old adult woman, using the attached portrait as the visual reference for her softly oval face, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, straight fine nose, full rose-colored lips, and long dark center-parted waves. She sits at a waist-high instrument table in an observatory instrument room at blue hour, wearing a charcoal sleeveless tailored top. Her left wrist wears a wide sculptural silver cuff with one raised oval green cabochon in a smooth bezel. The cuff is the visual hero: its continuous curved silver band, separate bezel rim, polished green dome, and open-ended construction are individually readable. Her left elbow stays bent close to her ribs while her left palm supports the underside of a shallow lightweight specimen tray, lifting it a few centimeters above the tabletop. Her right hand lightly steadies the tray's opposite rim; both connected forearms and all fingertips remain visible. The left wrist's outer surface turns toward the camera, placing the cuff above the tray rim with a clear skin-to-metal boundary. A small dark meteorite rests inside the tray. Her face inclines toward the stone with a calm, attentive expression. Frame a vertical waist-up three-quarter photograph with the cuff near the lower center and her face above it, giving the product enough image area to inspect its shape. A large neutral softbox with black flags draws clean broad highlights along the silver and a soft reflection across the stone while retaining its green body color. The cuff and eyes share crisp useful detail, with dark telescope hardware and a faint blue window softly resolved behind her. Visible pores, fine hair strands, credible finger joints, and restrained commercial retouching give the campaign a tangible photographic finish.
